goal: bun run e2e:live records cassettes and writes schema-valid live evidence for the release commit, and promote accepts only live evidence with passing required journeys J1, J2 and J4 (Spec D6, D7) (Initiative e2e-release-gate slice S9; Spec docs/specs/e2e-release-gate.spec.md).

acceptance.assertion: The live runner, exercised with the mock model standing in for the real model, writes docs/evidence/e2e-live/<version>.json matching immune_brain/e2e_release_evidence/v1 with version, commit, Host versions, per-journey results and each retry recorded. Negative case: a journey that fails twice is recorded as failed with both attempts. Done looks like: tests/e2e-live-evidence.test.ts validates the written file and the double-failure record.

release-promote.ts promote mode refuses checklist-mode evidence and refuses live evidence whose J1, J2 or J4 result is failing or missing, each before any write, while passing live evidence promotes. Done looks like: tests/release-promote.test.ts covers the checklist refusal, the failing and missing journey refusals and the passing case.
